title: Retrieval Sufficiency Repair
motivation: I3.13 showed RecallAll=0.1467 and P(success|RecallAll=1)=0.86 vs P(success|RecallAll=0)=0.03. Retrieval is the dominant bottleneck (124.25 utility points lost). The downstream architecture is already strong when given correct inputs (97.9% conditional success).
scientific_question: Does increasing RequiredEvidenceRecall from ~0.22 toward 0.7-0.9 produce a proportional increase in TaskUtility, while keeping all downstream components frozen?

Q2_HYBRID.description: Hybrid BM25 + dense with score fusion
Q2_HYBRID.retriever: BM25 + BGE-small, reciprocal rank fusion (RRF k=60)

Q4_ORACLE.description: Oracle retrieval ceiling (all required passages supplied)

secondary: RecallAny@k (fraction of tasks with >=1 required passage)
RecallAll@k (fraction of tasks with all required passages)

success_criteria.primary: Identify retrieval configuration that maximizes RequiredEvidenceRecall while keeping downstream frozen
success_criteria.secondary: Demonstrate that RecallAll increase produces TaskUtility increase
